BiblicalUsage: Beth-Baal-Meon means "house of Baal." It was a city in the territory of Reuben. It turns up in Joshua 13:17 and Jeremiah 48:23.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beth-Baal-Meon matters because the land itself is part of the promise.
